[1/5] Plan: /api/android metadata endpoint; a live APK card in web Setup (version, size, SHA-256, download, install page); Android 1.2 with Open gallery and background-status reporting; rebuild APK; tests, UI review, publish

impact_assessment.why: The server already builds and serves an APK, but the main gallery UI only has a small link to the separate install page. The objective asks for an APK download section in the web UI and proper Android integration
impact_assessment.benefits: Users see the current APK version, size and checksum inside the signed-in gallery, download it directly, and the app can open the gallery and report its last background run
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new public metadata route, new Setup markup and APK 1.2/3; dependency: stdlib and existing Android SDK only; concurrency: metadata read only; state: SharedPreferences last_background only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the sidecar as the source of truth, return available=false for missing/malformed files, keep existing install page and APK route, failing-first HTTP/static tests, rebuild and signature-verify APK, run 217+ tests and 4/4 gates, repeat UI evidence review
